display_information.name: wake-bot
display_information.description: Lift an idle window for a while, from Slack
display_information.long_description: Creates a WakeRequest in the Kubernetes namespace mapped to the channel the command was run in. The request carries a duration and a reason, expires on its own, and is capped by the IdleWindow policy for that namespace. The bot holds no state and cannot edit the policy itself.

slash_commands.description: Keep this namespace awake for a while
